description: We are seeking a dedicated Full-time Certified Occupational Therapy Assistant (COTA) to join a premier skilled nursing facility in Gainesville, FL. This is an excellent opportunity for a COTA passionate about making a significant impact on patients' lives through comprehensive rehabilitation services.In this role, you will work collaboratively with a multidisciplinary team to implement individualized treatment plans, helping residents regain independence and improve their quality of life. We offer a competitive hourly rate of $28.00 - $37.00, reflecting your experience and commitment to patient care. Join a supportive environment where your skills are valued and professional growth is encouraged.
requirements: Associate's degree from an accredited Certified Occupational Therapy Assistant (COTA) program
Current and valid COTA license in the state of Florida
Minimum of 1 year of experience as a COTA, preferably in a skilled nursing or rehabilitation setting
salaryOrBonusInfo: Competitive hourly rate of $28.00 - $37.00, based on experience.
